title: Context Fabric Result Feedback v1
description: The caller's feedback on one of its own Ask Dev results: GET and POST /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/feedback/{result_id}. A result takes feedback only when GET /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/{result_id} would serve it to the caller now and it completed an Ask Dev submission (it has an owner); any other result id, an unknown or malformed one included, gets the same 404 not_found. The feedback is part of the result's backing set and goes with its retention.

correct.description: Whether the caller found the answer correct: yes, no, or unset.

useful.description: Whether the caller found the answer useful: yes, no, or unset.

updated_at.description: When the feedback was last set. Absent when it was never set; both flags are then unset.
